registration: Same reviewed config writer/worker execution, quiescent q-attention only; add exact fixed recipe on both controller/worker; preserve all old recipes/other projects; source pin at new reviewed commit and readback effective runtime. No scheduler code change or GPU reservation.
recovery: Pure seeded source fixture may be manually retried after proven terminal failure with a new attempt; no adoption/automatic replay or training resume.
rollback: Restore exact project projections under existing writer locks with CAS only if they still equal installed projections; preserve other projects and all task history. Code is added in isolated worktrees, never overwrite dirty checkout.
